value.rationale: The infinite parameter distribution governing an intermittent random system is reconstructed uniquely and explicitly from its stationary marginal, replacing order-only shell estimates by a complete parameter–invariant bijection. Arbitrarily heavy-tailed laws are included: the precise E B threshold for finite versus infinite invariant mass and the iid physical-time return distribution quantify the source’s finite/infinite mechanism. This is a motivated natural inverse and return-time classification, not merely a numerical recomputation or routine normalization.
